indexing.label: Indexing
indexing.help: Pulls in file changes and updates the semantic search index. With this off, new files won't be searchable.

search.label: Semantic search
search.help: Accept semantic queries from the search UI. Off disables intelligence search; filename search keeps working through core.

rag.label: AI question answering (Ask)
rag.help: Enable the Ask feature. Each question sends file contents (transcripts, captions, text) to the LLM API. Use a local LLM for privacy-sensitive content.

auto_tags.label: AI-suggested tags
auto_tags.help: Generate candidate tags from file contents. Manual = on user request. Auto = generated for every newly indexed file. Suggestions only — they're not applied until you Approve.

summaries.label: AI summary (short)
summaries.help: 1-sentence short summary plus a paragraph long summary. Auto generates one for every newly indexed file, scaling cost linearly.

detailed_summaries.label: AI detailed summary (Markdown)
detailed_summaries.help: Long-form summary including a key-points table. Auto adds thousands of tokens per file. Local LLMs or cheap cloud tiers recommended.

transcript_refine.label: AI transcript refinement
transcript_refine.help: Run ASR transcripts through the LLM for punctuation and homophone fixes. Originals are kept and reverts are always possible. Transcripts are sent to the LLM API.

vision_describe.label: AI image description
vision_describe.help: Describe images (HEIC included) with a vision LLM. Image bytes are sent to the LLM API on each generation. For private photos, prefer Off or a local vision model. Requires vision_model to be set on the LLM provider.

llm.title: LLM provider
llm.description: Selects the language model used for tag generation, summaries, Ask, and image description. A local LLM (ollama) keeps data in the container; a cloud provider needs the API key in the environment. Restart the container for changes to take effect.
llm.saved: Saved — restart required for the change to take effect
llm.overridesActive: Values set from this GUI are shadowing the ones in search-config.yml
llm.overridesHelp: If you want to drive intelligence from the YAML file directly, reset the GUI settings
llm.resetSuccess: Reset — restart required for the change to take effect
llm.modelHelp: e.g. gemma4:e4b (ollama), gpt-4o-mini, deepseek-chat. Use whatever model name your provider exposes
llm.visionModelHelp: Model used for image description. Empty disables vision_describe even if the feature is on. e.g. llava:13b, gpt-4o-mini

providerHelp.disabled: Disable every AI feature (only indexing and search remain).
providerHelp.ollama: Talk to a local ollama server. Data stays inside your container. Reasoning models (DeepSeek-R1, Gemma 4, etc.) run with think:false.
providerHelp.openai_compatible: OpenAI / DeepSeek / Groq / vLLM / LM Studio etc. File contents are sent over the network — keep your privacy posture in mind.

llm.apiKeyHelp: API keys are read from the LLM_API_KEY environment variable. They cannot be edited from the GUI.
llm.apiKeyRequired: The selected provider needs LLM_API_KEY. Add it to .env, run `docker compose up -d`, then resave.

personalHistory.label: Use viewing history
personalHistory.help: Lets queries like "what I watched last week" or "things I haven't seen this month" filter to your own viewing history. Requires a profile (lit_viewer cookie).

categoryExpansion.label: Expand semantic categories
categoryExpansion.help: Lets the LLM rewrite vague queries ("sci-fi-ish", "horror-style") into a small set of synonyms for multi-query retrieval. Adds an LLM call per question.
